answer: To resist fake identities, require every agent to post a refundable security bond before its first trade. A falcon-style verification period supervises the newcomer's early transactions while an independent bridge panel of long-standing peers reviews its behavioral fingerprint. Spawning thousands of Sybils means locking thousands of bonds and enduring thousands of review windows, converting cheap spam into an expensive capital commitment. Honest agents earn yarrow-strong standing from settled, attestable trades, and that non-transferable reputation is what counterparties price in.
